domains.title: Bone mechanotransduction
queries: "osteocyte mechanotransduction" OR "bone mechanotransduction" OR "mechanical loading bone Wnt"
"osteocyte" AND ("sclerostin" OR "Piezo1" OR "YAP" OR "TAZ" OR "fluid shear")

domains.title: Bacterial sporulation
queries: "Bacillus subtilis sporulation" OR "Spo0A phosphorelay"
"sporulation" AND ("asymmetric division" OR "forespore" OR "mother cell") AND Bacillus

domains.title: Quorum sensing
queries: "quorum sensing" AND (LuxR OR LasR OR RhlR OR autoinducer OR virulence OR biofilm)
"quorum sensing" AND (phosphorelay OR "small RNA" OR "gene regulation" OR Vibrio)

domains.title: Plant circadian clock
queries: Arabidopsis AND ("circadian clock" OR CCA1 OR LHY OR TOC1 OR PRR OR ELF)
plant AND ("circadian oscillator" OR "circadian clock") AND (entrainment OR light OR temperature)

domains.title: Synaptic LTP/LTD
queries: ("long-term potentiation" OR "long-term depression" OR LTP OR LTD) AND (NMDA OR AMPA OR CaMKII OR calcineurin)
hippocampal AND ("synaptic plasticity" OR "AMPA receptor trafficking" OR "spine plasticity")

domains.title: Limb regeneration
queries: (axolotl OR salamander) AND "limb regeneration"
blastema AND ("positional memory" OR FGF OR Wnt OR BMP OR "retinoic acid" OR nerve)

domains.title: Biofilm formation and dispersal
queries: biofilm AND (dispersal OR "c-di-GMP" OR "quorum sensing" OR matrix OR motility)
"biofilm dispersal" OR "cyclic di-GMP" OR "extracellular matrix" OR exopolysaccharide

domains.title: Fungal metabolic switching
queries: (Candida OR yeast OR fungal) AND ("metabolic switching" OR "metabolic reprogramming" OR morphogenesis)
Candida AND (glycolysis OR gluconeogenesis OR TOR OR PKA OR hyphae) AND virulence

domains.title: Insect ecdysone signaling
queries: (ecdysone OR EcR OR USP OR Broad OR E74 OR E75) AND (insect OR metamorphosis)
ecdysone AND ("juvenile hormone" OR metamorphosis OR molting OR "gene cascade")

domains.title: Plant stomatal ABA signaling
queries: ("guard cell" OR "stomatal closure") AND (ABA OR "abscisic acid" OR OST1 OR SLAC1 OR SnRK2)
"abscisic acid" AND ("ion channel" OR PYR OR PYL OR RCAR OR calcium) AND plant

domains.title: Bacterial chemotaxis
queries: "bacterial chemotaxis" OR "Escherichia coli chemotaxis"
chemotaxis AND (CheA OR CheY OR CheR OR CheB OR "flagellar motor")

domains.title: C. elegans dauer formation
queries: (Caenorhabditis OR "C. elegans") AND dauer AND (insulin OR "TGF beta" OR DAF-16)
dauer AND (pheromone OR dafachronic OR "nuclear hormone receptor" OR developmental) AND elegans
